data.title: Weather Forecast for Friday
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- According to the National Center for Meteorology, moderate to heavy thunderstorms accompanied by winds and hail are expected to cause flash floods in parts of Aseer Region. Light to moderate thunderstorms are expected in parts of Jazan, Al-Baha, and Makkah regions. Fog may form in parts of these regions as well as in parts of Eastern Region.
    Winds over the Red Sea will be northwesterly to northeasterly at speeds of 15–35 km/h in the northern and central parts and southeasterly to southwesterly at speeds of 15 to over 60 km/h in the southern part. Waves will range from half a meter to one and a half meters; the sea will be calm to choppy.
    In the Arabian Gulf, winds will be southwesterly to northwesterly at speeds of 10–28 km/h in the northern part and northwesterly to westerly at speeds of 10 to over 50 km/h in the southern part. Waves will range from half a meter to over two meters; the sea will be calm to choppy.
    -- SPA
10:23 Local Time 07:23 GMT
